articles.title: Blue Planet III is keeping the rough edges in the age of AI
articles.essence: BBC's Blue Planet III is looking to prove its authenticity by leaving in the less-than-perfect shots. Previous incarnations of the nature series were defined by their gorgeous, crystal-clear footage that seemed almost too good to be real.
articles.full_body: BBC's Blue Planet III is looking to prove its authenticity by leaving in the less-than-perfect shots. articles.title: Pennsylvania will require labels on AI-generated ads
articles.essence: On Thursday, Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro signed the Artificial Intelligence Deceptive Advertising Act into law, requiring disclosures on AI-generated ads. The law requires any ad - whether it's a still image, video, audio, or text - that "has been significantly modified or generated by artificial intelligence" to include a label in the same format as […]
